bestBets.overview: SPICY APPLE is going to start short - with reason as one of only two last start placegetters here. He went close to the prize last start with a gap to third. AFFINEDEEL is the other recent placegetter, showing nice improvement at only his second run for the Hamblin stable. As the only on pace runner here, JULEP should get a nice run in front with a slower tempo than the shorter races she has been contesting being likely to suit. WHERE EAGLES DARE ran a better race up in trip last start; a couple of lengths behind Spicy Apple. BOUCHEREIGN struggled on the heavy last time and finds firmer here.

raceTips.comment: Spicy Apple deserves to be odds-on. This is a very moderate race and with even luck he should be too good. He comfortably defeated key rivals last start and could be better suited now given he was 46-days between runs going into that effort. His form has been consistent on wet and dry tracks.
